content.value: The following consecutive readings were taken with a level and a 4-meter leveling staff on a continuously sloping ground at common intervals of 50 m: 0.855 m (on A), 1.545 m, 2.335m, 3.115 m, 3.825 m, 0.045 m, 1.380 m, 2.055 m, 3.455 m, 0.585 m, 1.015 m, 1.850 m, 2.755 m and 3.845 m (on B). The RL of A was 105.500 m. Make entries in a level book and applies the usual checks. The change points were taken at 150 m and 400 m in chainage.
